## Narrative

### Template 1 — 5-star with specific praise

**Inbound:**
> "Joey was great! Got me cleaned up for my brother's wedding next week."

**Response template:**
> Thanks for the love, Mike — appreciate you trusting us with the wedding cut!

**Variation rules:**
- Reference the specific service mentioned in 1 of every 3 responses
- If a barber's name is in the review, name them back
- Use first name only
- 1-2 sentences max
- Don't include URLs, prices, or promo codes

### Template 2 — 5-star, generic

**Inbound:**
> "Best barber in town!"

**Response template:**
> Appreciate it! Thanks for the support — see you for the next one.

**Rules:**
- 1 sentence is enough; padding makes it look auto-generated
- Don't upsell
